So we're fine with the api contrary to what I said earlier. I updated the example accordingly. Feel free to try it/make your suggestion if you think of an easier way.

On another PR, what I want to do, is changing our props validation. Basically if a user provides a state we should make sure the onStateChange is their, the createURL remaining optional. But a user must be able to provide an onStateChange function without an associated state. Do we agree on this ?
